lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。

lines.en: This is my little brother, George.
lines.zh: 这是我的弟弟，乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。

lines.en: And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Best Friend.
lines.zh: 最好的朋友。

lines.en: Peppa is waiting for her best friend, Suzy Sheep.
lines.zh: 佩奇在等她最好的朋友，小羊苏西。

lines.en: Hello, Suzy!
lines.zh: 你好，苏西！

lines.en: Baaaa! Hello, Peppa.
lines.zh: 咩——！你好，佩奇。

lines.en: Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa.
lines.zh: 小羊苏西来找佩奇玩了。

lines.en: Peppa loves Suzy. Suzy loves Peppa.
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢苏西，苏西也喜欢佩奇。

lines.en: They are best friends.
lines.zh: 她们是最好的朋友。

lines.en: Peppa, why don't you and Suzy go and play in your bedroom?
lines.zh: 佩奇，你和苏西为什么不去卧室玩呢？

lines.en: Yes, Mummy!
lines.zh: 好呀，妈妈！

lines.en: George wants to play, too.
lines.zh: 乔治也想一起玩。

lines.en: Peppa and Suzy love playing in Peppa's bedroom.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西喜欢在佩奇的卧室里玩。

lines.en: So does George.
lines.zh: 乔治也一样。

lines.en: No, George. This game is just for big girls.
lines.zh: 不行，乔治。这个游戏只给大女孩玩。

lines.en: Go and play with your own toys.
lines.zh: 去玩你自己的玩具吧。

lines.en: Peppa and Suzy want to play on their own.
lines.zh: 佩奇和苏西想自己玩。

lines.en: I'm a tiny little fairy princess!
lines.zh: 我是一个小小的仙女公主！

lines.en: I'm going to wave my magic wand and turn you into a frog!
lines.zh: 我要挥一挥魔法棒，把你变成青蛙！

lines.en: George doesn't like playing on his own.
lines.zh: 乔治不喜欢自己一个人玩。

lines.en: No, George! I'm playing with Suzy. You'll have to play somewhere else.
lines.zh: 不行，乔治！我在和苏西玩，你得去别处玩。

lines.en: George wants to play with Peppa. He feels a bit lonely.
lines.zh: 乔治想和佩奇玩，他有点孤单。

lines.en: George, I need some help. I'm making chocolate chip cookies.
lines.zh: 乔治，我需要帮忙。我在做巧克力曲奇。

lines.en: Someone needs to lick out the bowl.
lines.zh: 得有人把碗舔干净。

lines.en: I want to be a nurse. I want to be a doctor.
lines.zh: 我想当护士。我想当医生。

lines.en: But who's gonna be the sick person?
lines.zh: 可是谁来当病人呢？

lines.en: Now George, take a big breath in, then cough.
lines.zh: 乔治，现在深吸一口气，然后咳嗽。

lines.en: I think your heart's a bit loose. How about a plaster on it?
lines.zh: 我觉得你的心跳有点松，贴个创可贴吧？

lines.en: Oh dear, you're very, very hot.
lines.zh: 哎呀，你发烧得很厉害。

lines.en: I think you have to stay in bed for three years!
lines.zh: 我觉得你得在床上躺三年！

lines.en: Oh no! What's wrong with George?
lines.zh: 噢不！乔治怎么了？

lines.en: Don't worry, Daddy. It's only a game. George is our patient.
lines.zh: 别担心爸爸，只是游戏。乔治是我们的病人。

lines.en: Can the patient have a visitor? Just for a little while.
lines.zh: 病人可以见访客吗？只能一小会儿。

lines.en: Cookies! Yes, they're for George. They're his medicine.
lines.zh: 饼干！对，是给乔治的，是他的药。

lines.en: Excuse me, doctor, can you help me? I have a sore tummy.
lines.zh: 医生打扰一下，能帮我看看吗？我肚子痛。

lines.en: I can hear it rumbling. I think you're hungry, Daddy!
lines.zh: 我听到咕噜咕噜响。爸爸你其实是饿了！

lines.en: Then I think I need lots of cookies to make me better.
lines.zh: 那我得吃好多饼干才能好。

lines.en: And me! And me! And me!
lines.zh: 还有我！还有我！还有我！
